title: OneSteel Limited - proposed acquisition of certain assets of Smorgon Steel Group Limited

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
ACCC requested further information from OneSteel.
ACCC received requested information from OneSteel.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
At the request of OneSteel, the announcement of the ACCC's decision has been delayed.

Request for informal clearance withdrawn. OneSteel has requested informal clearance for an acquisition of Smorgon Steel Group Limited except for the Smorgon distribution business. The ACCC will conduct a separate assessment of this proposal. Details of this assessment can be found under 'Public informal merger clearances under consideration'.
